headline: Revolut Signs 10-Year Lease for New Headquarters in Central Dublin
summary: Financial technology firm Revolut signed a 10-year lease agreement for a new headquarters location in central Dublin. The digital bank will occupy office space at the former Ulster Bank headquarters.
why: Revolut is one of Europe's largest digital banking fintechs, offering retail payments, crypto services, and international currency exchange.

impacts.name: Revolut
impacts.why: Digital bank Revolut signed a decade-long real estate commitment to support European growth.
